## Checklist

- [ ] Added or edited an object in `data/entries.json` (no manual README edits)
- [ ] Entry is in the right category and alphabetical by name within it
- [ ] `url` points to official docs or the project site, and it loads
- [ ] Description is factual, one sentence, 160 characters or fewer
- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes
- [ ] `node scripts/build-readme.mjs` was run and the README change is included
- [ ] No em-dash or en-dash characters
